name: Deep Dweller
descr: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

data.motivesAndTactics: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take **3d10+4** direct magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until spotlighted.

features.name: Brain Drain
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a _Vulnerable_ PC within Very Close range. The target marks **1d4** Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Call of the Deep
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to summon **1d4** Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Mucosal Contamination
features.text: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is _Restrained_ until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs _Restrained_ in this way take **3d8** direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures _Restrained_ by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.
